question: When I cast the copy of a card encoded with cipher, is the copy created in and cast from exile?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: the copy is created in and cast from exile.
expected.answer: The copy of the card with cipher is created in and cast from exile.

whyHard: Players think a copy of a spell is made on the stack, so they do not see where it is cast from.
